Specification: This module demonstrates integrating TLC with third-party tools by exporting counterexamples or error traces. It defines an alternative initial predicate for an imported distributed termination-detection model, a real invariant that fails after a bounded TLC level, and two wrapper invariants that either serialize the TLC trace to JSON or send it to a web endpoint when the real invariant is violated.
